description: Search the catalog by title or author within one language, returning matching book records (title, author, lang, slug, chapter_count, word_count and URLs). When to use: you have a title or author and need the lang+slug that every other tool requires. Do not use: to find words inside the text of books - that is cyberlibrary_fulltext_search. Returns: {query, lang, searched_languages, matches_returned, books[']}.

lang.description: Language code to search in (required), e.g. en, zh-cn.

query.description: Substring matched against title and author (case-insensitive).

name: cyberlibrary_search_books
title: Cyberlibrary Search Books
